spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes public eBay behavior for the whole workspace. It is not a preview, and nothing asks the seller again before SpellBook acts on the new mode.
Only the workspace owner may call it. An admin or member gets delegated_agent_workspace_owner_required.
Set a mode only after the seller chose it in their own words. Never pick one for them, and never read silence as a choice. New workspaces start on manual.
The response is the saved setting. Call spellbook_store_setup_status afterwards and tell the seller ebayAutomation.meaning in plain words.

auto_list and full answer 409 ebay_setup_incomplete until eBay setup has finished, the same check the web app makes before it offers them. The reason names each unfinished step and the SpellBook page where the seller finishes it. Nothing is saved on a 409.

auto_list and full answer agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while SpellBook has agent marketplace writes switched off, the switch that also governs spellbook_ebay_publish. manual always saves, so an agent can always turn eBay automation off. Switching agent marketplace writes off later also stops an auto_list or full an agent set earlier: SpellBook treats it as manual until the switch is back on or the seller picks a mode in the web app.
auto_list and full list nothing without a saved eBay pricing strategy.

After the owner chooses auto_list, eligible stock already in this workspace enters the existing eBay discovery schedule, and future imports and scans use the saved eBay pricing and listing rules. This saves the policy and starts the existing discovery flow; it does not confirm that every eligible item is live or reprice listings already live.
Setting full also starts a pass that sorts the workspace's eBay inventory into per-set listings.

basicLandsEnabled false stops new automatic single listings of basic lands, but a basic land single listing that is already live stays live. It also drops basic lands from per-set listings, so a per-set listing that holds only basic lands ends. An explicit spellbook_ebay_publish still lists a basic land.
basicLandsEnabled true answers agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while agent marketplace writes are switched off. false always saves.

maxQuantityPerListing caps new stacked listings and quantity top-ups of live listings. It does not lower the quantity of a listing that is already live above the cap. Copies above the cap stay owned and unlisted on eBay.
Any maxQuantityPerListing value, null included, answers agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while agent marketplace writes are switched off.

description: Set one workspace's eBay automation mode, basic-land preference, copy cap, or month-end allowance policy after the owner chooses the setting. Month-end defaults to off with a 1,000-insertion reserve. Optional stale-single refreshes run in the final 48 hours and stop new ends two hours before the Pacific month resets. Read spellbook_ebay_month_end_status first for capacity and recovery facts. Only the workspace owner may change public listing behavior. The modes: manual: New listings and repricing stay manual. Recovery of listings already ended by month-end management can finish. auto_list: New eligible inventory lists on eBay automatically at your saved eBay pricing strategy's prices, and existing eBay listings are never repriced automatically. full: New inventory lists on eBay automatically, and existing eBay listings reprice from your saved eBay pricing strategy. With variation packages on (the default), new inventory groups into one listing per set with each card as a variation; with them off, each card lists on its own.

basicLandsEnabled.description: true lets auto_list and full list basic lands (Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain, Forest, Wastes, and their Snow-Covered printings). false skips them. The saved value defaults to false.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

maxQuantityPerListing.description: The most available copies one eBay listing may advertise, such as 3. null removes the cap. Omit it to keep the saved value, which defaults to null.

mode.description: The mode the seller chose: manual, auto_list, or full. Send mode, basicLandsEnabled, maxQuantityPerListing, or any mix.

monthEnd.description: The owner's month-end choice: enabled, reserve, and refreshStale. Enabling retains the reserve during automatic listing. refreshStale permits eligible older singles to refresh after new-stock work. Disabling stops new ends; recovery of already-ended stock continues.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose eBay automation mode to set. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_automation_set
